mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 67 degrees. Tonight, the moon is in a waning crescent phase. If you look up around 8:17 PM, you can catch the International Space Station rising over Belleville and cruising toward the Fitchburg and Madison area for a five-minute show, reaching about halfway up the sky.

City updates today include an arrest by the Verona Police Department regarding a 2019 case of a school staff member. In local infrastructure, road construction for the Aldi development continues, with traffic shifting and lane changes expected this week. Also, take a stroll to Century School Park to see the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics wood carving, a beautiful piece by local artists now on display.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, join Hop Haus Trivia or check out Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department issued a release regarding an investigation into an incident that took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026. A 34-year-old Madison resident was arrested for an alleged inappropriate relationship with a student from 2019, and the investigation remains open.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for a scoop of Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, our flavor of the day. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
